typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{} as decimal(0,0)
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	format: 'table',
	staged:false) ~> SRCOLEDBDETAILRPT
SRCOLEDBDETAILRPT sink(input(
		TOTAL as decimal(0,0),
		COV_FROM_DT as string,
		COV_TO_DT as string,
		SEGMENT as string,
		LICS_AMT as decimal(0,0),
		PAYMENT_DT as string,
		MED_MBU as string,
		DRUG_PRODUCT as string,
		CONTRACT as string,
		SUBSCRIBERID as string,
		FUNDING_TYPE as string,
		DRUG_SUBSIDY_AMT as decimal(0,0),
		HICN as string,
		MED_REV_AMT as decimal(0,0),
		DRUG_REV_AMT as decimal(0,0),
		GROUP_ID as string,
		BU as string,
		LIS_AMT as decimal(0,0),
		MED_PRODUCT as string,
		CGD_AMT as decimal(0,0),
		PBP as string,
		REINS_AMT as decimal(0,0)
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		TOTAL,
		COV_FROM_DT = {COV FROM DT},
		COV_TO_DT = {COV TO DT},
		SEGMENT,
		LICS_AMT = {LICS AMT},
		PAYMENT_DT = {PAYMENT DT},
		MED_MBU = {MED MBU},
		DRUG_PRODUCT = {DRUG PRODUCT},
		CONTRACT,
		SUBSCRIBERID,
		FUNDING_TYPE = {FUNDING TYPE},
		DRUG_SUBSIDY_AMT = {SELCTD DRUG},
		HICN,
		MED_REV_AMT = {MED REV AMT},
		DRUG_REV_AMT = {DRUG REV AMT},
		GROUP_ID = {GROUP ID},
		BU,
		LIS_AMT = {LIS AMT},
		MED_PRODUCT = {MED PRODUCT},
		CGD_AMT = {CGD AMT},
		PBP,
		REINS_AMT = {REINS AMT})) ~> DSTFFDETAILRPT
